title: Public product, staff and service endpoints return projections, honour storeEnabled and are rate limited

GET bookings/public/businesses/:id/staff returns hourlyRate and maxHoursPerWeek.

title: Unified scheduler kill switch and a server-side KEY off switch for gateway dispatch and cortex crons

KF_DISABLE_SCHEDULERS and *_SCHEDULER_DISABLED are still honoured (additive).

title: Mount the business-level activity feed in the cockpit; bounded timeline limit
proof: RED-BEFORE at the R0 wave head: business-timeline.tsx has no importer. GET timeline with limit=10000 is accepted (query-timeline.dto.ts:296-299 has no @Max).
GREEN-AFTER: the cockpit renders payment_recorded and paid rows with amounts from /timeline/businesses/:id/events. limit 10000 gets 400. Tenant B's feed contains none of A's rows.

title: tRPC crm.contactDetail applies CRM visibility before reading child rows

title: The three booking writers that bypass the overlap guard (tRPC create, waitlist offer, calendar write-back) go through it
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-16 head: tRPC bookings.create, the waitlist offerSlot placeholder and calendar PATCH write-back each create an overlapping booking for an occupied staff slot (bookings.ts:32-45, booking-waitlist.service.ts:242-252, calendar-projection.service.ts:174-193).

title: Booking settlement: completion invoice nets the deposit, visible invoicing outcome, paymentStatus from invoices, live invoice.paid confirm hook
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-16 head: price 100 with deposit 25 paid gives a completion invoice of 100, re-billing the deposit (bookings.service.ts:1214). Booking.paymentStatus is never written. FlowListener.handleInvoicePaid tests payload.invoice.bookingId, which does not exist, so confirmBooking never runs (flow.listener.ts:80-87). The booking confirmation pages open the authenticated receipt and get 401.

GREEN-AFTER: the final invoice is 75 and references the deposit invoice; deposit + final == price in every case. Completing twice creates one final invoice. An invoicing failure leaves the booking COMPLETED with an explicit invoiceError in the response. A deposit PAID event sets DEPOSIT_PAID, a final PAID sets PAID, replays are idempotent and other tenants are ignored. invoice.paid confirms the booking through the relation. The confirmation pages link the token receipt (R0-26).

title: Manual refunds as separate negative rows, a defined full-refund state, agreeing gross and net

title: Required admission gate swaps from 'DAST (HawkScan)' to 'DAST (Native)'; HawkScan becomes manual-only

title: KeyActionProposal execution claims atomically and re-reads the approver

title: Storefront checkout retry identity (existing unique slot, no migration unless proven unavoidable) and CASH-order offline completion

title: Ledger-derived cash position for the cockpit and safe-to-spend

title: Currency integrity: business-currency defaults, per-currency stats, single-currency guard at the posting door

title: Honest GDPR purge with retained-basis audit; Contact.status vocabulary ratchet (Shopify maps, never overwrites)

title: Evidence-extracted and Drive-intake payments are recorded PENDING until an operator confirms (decision-gated)
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1 base: an AI-extracted amount from payment evidence, and a Drive intake record_payment, each create a SUCCESSFUL posted Payment (payment-evidence.service.ts:160-176; drive-intake-orchestrator.service.ts:300-315).

title: Single invoice lifecycle owner: compare-and-set transitions; DelegationLoop and CommerceAi go through the workflow; status-writer ratchet
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-37 head: two concurrent transition(id,'OVERDUE') calls both succeed and invoice.overdue is emitted twice. DelegationLoop raw-sets OVERDUE with a flat payload (delegation-loop.service.ts:555). ai-execute mark_paid writes PAID with no payment or posting, and revenue:none can call it (commerce-ai.service.ts:814,825). title: Per-business sequential invoice/quote numbers allocated under the existing unique with P2002 retry (no migration)
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-42 head: Promise.all of 10 creates in one business hits P2002 inside one millisecond (INV-${Date.now()}, schema.prisma:3606 unique). After a soft-deleted invoice, KEY commerce_create_invoice computes INV-<count+1> and collides (flow-orchestrator.service.ts:3310-3328).

GREEN-AFTER: 10 rows with distinct sequential numbers. Two tenants number independently. An explicit invoiceNumber is honoured. The KEY tool, booking invoices and recurring invoices draw from the same allocator. Existing rows are not renumbered.
LEDGER: each allocated invoice posts once on issue, and a retry never creates a second Invoice or FinancialTransaction.
rationale: M22 and CF-37: three numbering schemes exist and none is safe under concurrency. A counter table is not needed when allocation retries under the existing unique, which honours the no-migration rule.

title: Credit-note apply reachable (sourceType 'Invoice'), void converges, statuses owned by the workflow
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-42 head: an issued ACCRUAL invoice plus apply credit note throws, because it searches sourceType 'INVOICE' while postings say 'Invoice' (credit-note.service.ts:111,124). Voiding an APPLIED note flips status without reversing.

GREEN-AFTER: apply posts a REVERSAL of kind credit_note_applied. Voiding an APPLIED note posts an offsetting transaction and restores the invoice status through workflow transitions for the credited states decided in D-28 (added to the transition table in this packet). Voiding a DRAFT posts nothing. There are no direct status writes in credit-note.service.ts.
LEDGER: credited amount plus remaining equals the invoice total, and the trial balance balances.
rationale: CF-42: the only P0-4 reversal primitive is unreachable, and its void leaves consequences active.

title: Create idempotency key for invoices and quotes (isolated migration, only if D-15 confirms no existing unique slot)
proof: WHY A MIGRATION MAY BE UNAVOIDABLE: Invoice and Quote have no free unique column. R0-D2's trick reused Payment.providerPaymentId, which has no equivalent on documents. The packet first proves no existing column can carry the key; otherwise it stops. It runs alone in the main tree.
RED-BEFORE at the V1-43 head: the same create posted twice (network retry) gives two invoices.

GREEN-AFTER: the same Idempotency-Key gives one row and the same id. A different body with the same key gets 409. The web createInvoice and createQuote send one key per form open. prisma migrate diff is clean, and db:deploy applies on a fresh database.
LEDGER: one Invoice row, and at most one invoice_finalized posting per key.
rationale: M22: create has no idempotency. The migration is isolated by rule.

title: Token-gated customer pay surface: /pay/link/[token] stops downgrading to the bare-id page (decision-gated)
proof: RED-BEFORE at the V1-45 head: after one visit, /pay/link/[token] and public/invoice/[token] router.replace to /pay/:invoiceId. Deactivating the link then has no effect, because every API on that page is id-keyed (pay/link/[token]/page.tsx:18-40).

GREEN-AFTER: pay actions are keyed by token. A deactivated or expired link gets 404 on every customer action. The bare-id page is retired or token-gated as decided in D-07, and payment-intent is reachable only through a live token.
LEDGER: no payment or posting is reachable through a revoked token.
rationale: M34: pay-link revocation and expiry are unenforceable while every token path downgrades to the bare id.
